limitations: Policy only: consumer must authenticate/authorize freshly and verify exclusive upstream TLS before forwarding; no listener or customer transport is added.
Authorization and reserved auth cookie namespaces are unsupported for customer app auth in this first pilot.
Root service workers are blocked on fresh origins; existing workers are not removed. Fresh never-reused private origins are required; in-place conversion unsupported until migration proof.
Header bounds are not body/concurrency/admission/distributed rate or cost enforcement.
WebSocket upgrades are rejected by this HTTP policy; separate origin/revalidation/limits remain.
Full repository >=95, AWS private ingress/direct-origin denial, data/secrets/usage, publish/share/invitation UI/tools and hosted acceptance remain unmet.
